pages.title: 1. Place controls
pages.html:
Breath Tutorial

Load a PNG, then use Point for local anchors and Trait for freehand warp or lock regions.

Use unmovable controls around shoulders, pelvis, props, or hard edges. Those locks intentionally win over animated points and traits.

pages.title: 2. Tune motion
pages.html:
Tune Motion

Offset X/Y defines the maximum movement. Warp angle rotates that movement while preserving its distance.

Breath strength is global. Enable Custom breath on a point or trait when that control needs a stronger or weaker movement than the rest of the image.

pages.title: 3. Reuse on many images
pages.html:
Ratio Presets

Export ratio preset stores point and trait positions as image ratios instead of pixels.

Batch apply loads that preset, asks for several PNG files, then exports GIF, APNG, or spritesheet plus JSON and atlas for every selected image.
